newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle quiet, no trade - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle quiet, no trade - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the panhandle area early Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Week to date movement 600.

The last established price was $62.00 per cwt on Friday. Monday's packer bids were $62.00, with asking prices $64.00-$66.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
